template.name: Vessel Health Corroboration and Discovery Liveness Gate
template.description: Closes gap in detection of stale registrations with broken producers. Audits vessel_registry against impulse_resolution_metrics over 24h rolling window, identifies shapes with ≥80% resolution failure rate from advertised vessel, and proposes discovery-side liveness gate activity. Tags output for Thompson sampling and gates future discovery results by recent resolution success.

params.prompt: Given the following code artifacts and failure-mode scenario, synthesize a vessel-health-corroboration activity that: (1) queries impulse_resolution_metrics for vessels with ≥80% failure rate in last 24h, (2) cross-references against vessel_registry for fresh (non-expired) registrations, (3) identifies false-positive unproducible-shape flags, (4) proposes a discovery-side liveness gate that filters findByShape results by recent resolution success, (5) outputs vesselHealthCorroboration shape with per-vessel per-shape failure rates and liveness recommendations. Include specific SQL query structure, activity pseudo-code, and integration points.
